note: Camping here is at the area's two small gravel parking lots, each marked by MDC for primitive camping: this one beside the old fire tower on the paved road at the south-west edge, and one at the north-east corner off County Road 322. No pads, tables or toilets; forested Ozark ridges and glades with a marked trail system. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: lot camping that MDC designates (map Primitive Camping symbol beside each of the two Parking Lot symbols; a GIS camping point at each) - stays under the Lick Creek reading of the lot rule, flagged for the owner. Pin on the south (fire tower) lot, on a paved road. Phone matches. No split.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS, OWNER TO CONFIRM: the brochure says 'Camping is allowed anytime in designated camping areas. These may or may not have defined campsites... Walk-in/backpack camping is allowed.' The 8/21/2024 map shows exactly two Parking Lot symbols, each with a Primitive Camping symbol beside it, and GIS layer 27 has a point at each: 422 at 38.14045,-91.80889 (lot 346, 17 m) and 421 at 38.16557,-91.78958 (lot 345 is 110 m north-east of it). On imagery the south one is a gravel pull-in about 25 x 12 m on the north side of the paved road next to the fire tower; the north one a gravel pad about 20 x 15 m at the corner of a field at the end of a short spur off County Road 322, with the GIS point itself falling in closed woods south-west of the pad (nothing there on imagery). Neither shows pads, rings or tables. Designated points at the lots keep it; they are lots and nothing more.

PIN: stored 38.14045,-91.80889 is the south lot's GIS camping point, on the gravel beside the paved road. No move. It is the easier of the two for a 23-ft rig (paved approach, pull-in parallel to the road).
NO SPLIT: the north lot is 3.3 km away on its own road but is a single small lot. Nothing else in the database within 1.5 km of either.
ACCESS: south lot directly off the paved road signed from Highway 63 (map: 'Non-MDC Road'); north lot off gravel County Road 322. No posted limit or 4WD wording on the page, brochure or map.
PHONE: stored 573-815-7900 matches the page's 'For more information call (573) 815-7900'.
Stored year_round (manual) agrees with the brochure's 'allowed anytime'.
